text:
release_captain: Heads-up — code freeze for v1.12.0 starts in ~8 hours. Please avoid merging non-critical PRs after the cutoff. If you need a late merge, use the exception process below: open a PR, add the `late-merge` label, request approval in this thread, and make sure CI is green. No DB migrations during the freeze unless explicitly approved.

alex_k: Quick question — I have a small embedder config tweak (removes an old tokenization flag). No DB changes. Safe to go as a late-merge if reviewers sign off?

morgan: Who's owning the changelog for this cycle? We need a short line and the version bump note.

sam_lee: I have a docs-only change to release notes (typo + one-line clarification). Can I get a late-merge exception for that?

release_captain: Docs-only edits with no code or infra changes are fine to approve during freeze. @sam_lee open a PR, add `late-merge`, set milestone `v1.12.0`, and ping @morgan for changelog review.

ci-bot: PR #4821 (embedder-config) — CI: failing on unit tests (test_embedding_integration) on ubuntu-x86. See logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/4821

alex_k: Thanks @ci-bot — rerunning now. That test is flaky, but I'll wait for a clean run before requesting merge. If it flakes twice I'll revert the change.

nia: FYI, the release tool will bump the version automatically when we cut the release branch. If you need a manual semver tweak (e.g., force minor vs patch), call it out here and I'll coordinate.

release_captain: Quick decisions: (1) Approve @sam_lee docs PR once CI passes — go ahead and merge after labeling. (2) @alex_k hold the embedder change until CI is consistently green and @morgan signs off on the changelog blurb. (3) No DB migrations allowed during freeze — if unavoidable, file an incident ticket and we will triage for a hotfix window.

sam_lee: Merged and pushed with label `late-merge` and milestone v1.12.0 — thanks! :thumbsup:

release_captain: Late-merge checklist for visibility: 
1) PR created + `late-merge` label
2) CI green
3) Changelog entry (short, one line)
4) @release_captain approval in thread
5) Backport to release branch if necessary

Backport snippet (do this from your local dev machine):
```
# on your feature branch
git checkout release/v1.12.0
git pull origin release/v1.12.0
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
git push origin release/v1.12.0
```

morgan: I'll take changelog. For the embedder change, please add a one-liner under "Performance" referencing the model card, @alex_k. I'll approve once CI is green.

alex_k: Will add the changelog line and re-run tests. If CI still flaky, we'll hold until after freeze.

release_captain: :white_check_mark: final note — freeze goes live at T+8h. If something is truly blocking production, escalate here and we'll call an emergency patch window. Otherwise, hold non-critical merges until v1.12.1. Thanks all for coordinating.
